LEGAL AND PASSENGER NOTICES
_
ELECTRONIC TICKET
Fare rules and fees
•Depending on the fare rules, an additional payment may apply if you modify or cancel your booking.
•To avoid no-show fees, make sure you change or cancel your booking at least 3 hours before departure.
•When modifying a journey that includes a combination of fare types, the most restrictive fare rules will apply.
•Local tax(es) and levies may be collected at the airport, where applicable.
•Depending on the card issuer, additional transaction fees may apply.
•Additional information may need to be submitted to verify the identity of the cardholder
Before you fly
•Carry the required travel documents, including a copy of this confirmation
•Ensure that you follow the relevant immigration and health requirements
Baggage allowance
•Learn more about Qatar Airways baggage allowance, rules and restrictions at https://www.qatarairways.com/en/baggage.html
•If your itinerary includes a flight that is operated by a partner airline (code-share or interline), the baggage rules of the Most
Significant Carrier (MSC) apply in accordance with the regulations of the International Air Transport Association (IATA). As baggage
requirements may vary for each flight, you will find the most accurate details on the ticket.
•When travelling to or from the USA or Canada, the baggage rules for the flight at the beginning of the itinerary will apply throughout
the journey, regardless of stopovers, and transit.
•The carriage of certain hazardous materials, like aerosols, fireworks, and flammable liquids, aboard the aircraft is forbidden. If you do
not understand these restrictions, further information may be obtained from operating airline
Check-in
•Aim to arrive at the airport at least three hours before departure
•Online check-in for Qatar Airways operated flights is available up to 48 hours before departure and up to 24 hours before departure
to USA
Data Protection Notice
Your personal data will be processed in accordance with the applicable carrier's privacy policy and, if your booking is made via a

reservation system provider ("GDS"), with its privacy policy. These are available at https://www.iatatravelcentre.com/privacy.htm or
from the carrier or GDS directly. You should read this documentation, which applies to your booking and specifies, for example, how
your personal data is collected, stored, used, disclosed and transferred.
For Legal Notices and useful links, please visit www.qatarairways.com/terms
